changes: Every cell length is a derive.mjs row at the cell's scope font size n; the generator holds only the n ladder per tier and the density dial.
--g-unit is the inset I and --g-slot-height the slot S, so --g-height = S + 2I = h at density factor 1.
Custom property names are unchanged from the earlier geometry.css; layout.css is a hand-kept snapshot and is not generated.
